conditions.name: Viral Fever / Seasonal Influenza
sample_patient_utterances: Amar 2 din dhore matha batha r jor, sordi o legeche.
Mild fever with headache and runny nose since yesterday.
কাল থেকে হালকা জ্বর, মাথা ব্যথা ও সর্দি।
precautions: Take complete bed rest and drink plenty of fluids (warm water, lemon-ginger tea, soup).
Take Paracetamol (500mg) for fever and body ache as needed (max 3-4 times daily with food).
Perform warm saline gargles 2-3 times daily for sore throat relief.
Consult a general physician if fever persists beyond 3-4 days or rises above 102°F (38.9°C).
emergency_red_flags: Persistent high fever >103°F unresponsive to antipyretics
Shortness of breath or rapid breathing

conditions.name: Dengue Fever
sample_patient_utterances: Sudden high fever with intense bone ache and severe pain behind eyes.
Amar 2 din dhore khub jor shathe gayer sob haddi betha r chokhe betha.
হঠাৎ তীব্র জ্বর এসেছে এবং সারা গায়ে প্রচণ্ড ব্যথা ও চোখের পেছনে চাপ লাগছে।
precautions: Drink at least 3 liters of fluids daily (ORS, green coconut water, clear broth).
Perform Complete Blood Count (CBC) and NS1 antigen test within 24-48 hours.
Take Paracetamol for fever management; strictly avoid Aspirin, Ibuprofen, or other NSAIDs to avoid bleeding.
Monitor for warning signs: gum bleeding, black stool, persistent vomiting, severe abdominal pain.

conditions.name: Acute Coronary Syndrome / Heart Attack
sample_patient_utterances: Severe crushing chest pain radiating to left arm with cold sweat.
Buke onek chap lagche, ba haate betha choriye jacche r shash nite parchi na.
বুকে প্রচণ্ড চাপ ও ব্যথা, শ্বাস নিতে কষ্ট হচ্ছে এবং শরীর ঘেমে ঠান্ডা হয়ে যাচ্ছে।
precautions: IMMEDIATE ACTION: Stop all exertion and sit upright or in a comfortable semi-reclined position.
Do NOT drive yourself. Dial emergency dispatch (999) or proceed immediately to the nearest cardiac center.
Chew an uncoated Aspirin (300mg) if advised by an emergency clinician and not allergic.
Loosen any restrictive clothing around neck and chest.
emergency_red_flags: Loss of consciousness or near syncope

conditions.name: GERD / Acute Gastritis
sample_patient_utterances: Burning sensation in middle of chest and sour taste in throat after dinner.
Buke jala korche r tok dhekur uthche, pete onek gas.
খাওয়ার পর বুক জ্বলে এবং টক ঢেঁকুর আসে, পেট খুব ভারী লাগছে।
precautions: Avoid heavy, oily, fried, and spicy foods. Eat smaller, frequent meals.
Do not lie down immediately after eating; wait at least 2–3 hours.
Elevate head of bed by 6 inches when sleeping.
Drink lukewarm water; consider taking an antacid or PPI as advised by a doctor.

conditions.name: Migraine Headache
sample_patient_utterances: Severe throbbing pain on left side of head with sensitivity to bright light.
Amar mathar ba pashe thak thak kore betha korche r alor dike takano jacche na.
মাথার একপাশে তীব্র দপদপানি ব্যথা এবং আলো দেখলে কষ্ট বাড়ে।
precautions: Rest in a quiet, dark, and cool room.
Apply a cold cloth or ice pack to forehead or temples.
Maintain adequate hydration with water and electrolyte drinks.
Identify and avoid known migraine triggers (caffeine withdrawal, cheese, stress, lack of sleep).
emergency_red_flags: Sudden 'thunderclap' headache reaching peak intensity in seconds
Headache accompanied by stiff neck and high fever

conditions.name: Acute Gastroenteritis / Food Poisoning
conditions.bengali_name: ফুড পয়জনিং / তীব্র ডায়রিয়া ও বমি
sample_patient_utterances: Frequent loose stool and vomiting after eating street food yesterday.
Pet kharap hoyeche, bar bar patla paykhana r bomi hocche, khub durbol lagche.
বাইরের খাবার খাওয়ার পর থেকে ঘন ঘন পাতলা পায়খানা এবং বমি হচ্ছে।
precautions: Prepare Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) solution in clean drinking water and drink after each loose stool.
Avoid dairy, spicy, fatty, and sugary foods. Consume light khichuri, green banana mash, or rice water.
Do not take antimotility medications without physician advice if fever is present.
Wash hands thoroughly with soap before eating and after toilet use.
emergency_red_flags: Inability to keep fluids down for >12 hours
Severe sunken eyes, lack of urination for 8 hours, or extreme dizziness

conditions.name: Bronchial Asthma / Respiratory Distress
sample_patient_utterances: Sudden breathlessness and wheezing sound while breathing, worse at night.
Thanda lege shash kosto shuru hoyeche, buke bashi bajche r kashi thamche na.
বুকে বাঁশির মতো শব্দ হচ্ছে এবং শ্বাস নিতে অনেক কষ্ট হচ্ছে, কাশি হচ্ছে।
precautions: Immediately use your prescribed rescue inhaler (e.g. Salbutamol) with spacer if available.
Sit upright and lean slightly forward; avoid lying flat.
Stay away from active asthma triggers (dust, cold air, smoke, strong odors, animal fur).
Seek emergency medical evaluation if breathing does not improve within 10-15 minutes of inhaler use.
emergency_red_flags: Inability to speak full sentences in one breath
Peak flow reading below 50% of personal best

conditions.name: Urinary Tract Infection (UTI)
sample_patient_utterances: Intense burning pain while urinating and frequent urge every 15 minutes.
Prosrab korar somoy khub jala kore r tolpet betha kore, bar bar prosraber veg hoy.
প্রস্রাবের সময় ভীষণ জ্বালাপোড়া করে এবং ঘন ঘন প্রস্রাবের বেগ আসে।
precautions: Drink plenty of water (at least 2.5–3 liters per day) to flush bacteria.
Empty your bladder regularly without delaying urination.
Obtain a Urine Routine & Microscopic Examination (R/M/E) and Urine Culture before starting antibiotics.
Consult a certified doctor or urologist for targeted antibiotic therapy.
emergency_red_flags: High fever with shaking chills and rigors
Severe flank or lower back pain (suggestive of pyelonephritis/kidney infection)

conditions.name: Typhoid Fever
sample_patient_utterances: Fever rising every day for a week, accompanied by severe headache, stomach pain, and exhaustion.
1 shoptaho dhore protidin jor barbe, matha betha charche na r pete betha.
এক সপ্তাহ ধরে একটানা জ্বর এবং শরীর প্রচণ্ড দুর্বল ও পেটে ব্যথা।
precautions: Perform Widal test or Blood Culture / Typhidot as prescribed by physician.
Ensure water is boiled for at least 1 minute before drinking.
Eat well-cooked, soft foods; avoid raw vegetables and street food.
Complete the full course of prescribed antibiotics even if fever subsides.
emergency_red_flags: Severe intestinal bleeding or bloody stool
Acute sudden sharp abdominal pain (potential perforation)

conditions.name: Viral Hepatitis / Acute Jaundice
sample_patient_utterances: Eyes turned yellow, urine is dark amber, and complete loss of appetite with tiredness.
Chokh holud hoye geche, prosraber rong ghoro holud r khide ekebare nei.
চোখ হলুদ হয়ে গেছে এবং প্রস্রাবের রঙ গাঢ় হলুদ, কোনো খাবারের রুচি নেই।
precautions: Get Serum Bilirubin, SGPT/ALT, and Viral Hepatitis profile (Anti-HAV, HBsAg) checked.
Get plenty of bed rest during the acute symptomatic stage.
Avoid fatty, heavy food and alcohol completely; drink fresh hygienic fluids.
Avoid taking unprescribed herbal medicines or unverified traditional cures that harm liver function.
emergency_red_flags: Severe confusion, drowsiness, or altered sleep-wake cycle (hepatic encephalopathy)

conditions.name: Allergic Dermatitis / Urticaria
sample_patient_utterances: Severe itchy red rash and hives all over arms and chest after eating prawns.
Gaye chaka chaka lal daag utheche r oshojjo chulkani hocche.
সারা শরীরে লাল চাকা দাগ উঠেছে এবং ভীষণ চুলকাচ্ছে।
precautions: Do not scratch the affected skin to prevent secondary bacterial infection.
Apply cool compresses or calamine lotion to soothe inflamed skin.
Identify and eliminate suspected triggers (certain foods, detergents, fabrics, animal dander).
Consult a doctor for appropriate non-sedating oral antihistamines.
emergency_red_flags: Facial swelling, swelling of lips, tongue, or eyelids (angioedema)
